SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE41PARA style (GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL file assignment)

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese Medical Association (JMA) ORCA standard medical receipt billing system. This program creates monthly business receipt detail files for public disaster (公務災害) and self-pay (自費) insurance categories.
purpose.summary: ORCR0483 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. It reads indexed patient insurance and disease-name files (RECE41, RECE43, RECE47) and produces detailed receipt output files for public disaster and self-pay billing. It handles disease-name editing, receipt comments, and period-of-treatment formatting.

notable_features: 34 COPY statements with .INC copybooks and REPLACING clauses
Indexed sequential file I/O (ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, SEQUENTIAL access)
REDEFINES used for multi-format record layouts
OCCURS tables for hospital/system master data
No COMP-3 usage despite financial data
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
205 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
